name: homebridge-snapshot-sensors
description: Homebridge plugin that retrieves camera snapshots and runs on-device YOLO object detection

scripts.build:native: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/yolo-runner/Cargo.toml && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join('native','yolo-runner','target','release','snapshot-sensors-yolo');const bin=path.join('native','yolo-runner','bin','snapshot-sensors-yolo');const ort=process.env.ORT_LIB_LOCATION||path.join(process.cwd(),'native','yolo-runner','.ort','onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.28.0','lib');const dst=path.join('native','yolo-runner','onnxruntime');if(!fs.existsSync(src))throw new Error('Native YOLO runner was not built: '+src);if(!fs.existsSync(ort))throw new Error('ONNX Runtime library directory not found: '+ort);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(bin),{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,bin);for(const f of fs.readdirSync(ort)){if(f.startsWith('libonnxruntime.so'))fs.copyFileSync(path.join(ort,f),path.join(dst,f));}"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:native && tsc
